text:
sofia: Heads-up: Customer Z is asking for guaranteed non-preemptible slices during their monthly demos. They need a playbook for guaranteed capacity for 4 hours twice a month.
rahul: we could expose a 'demo-reserve' feature: scheduled reservation windows that temporarily mark capacity as non-preemptible.
max: do we have enough capacity in the targeted regions? quick check: us-east has more slack.
sofia: proposed UX: sales picks windows in console, ops confirms, feature flags toggle preemption off for that tenant during the window.
rahul: engineering notes: this will need scheduler hooks and a short path to toggle preemptiveness at runtime. Also need metering to ensure customers pay for the reserved window.
sofia: launch criteria: console button + email confirmation, audit log entries, billing tag, and rollback toggle.
ops-bot: scheduled-reservation-request created: id=SR-442, owner=sofia.
max: timeline: we can pilot with 2 customers next week. rahul: scope to MVP: manual approval + toggle via API. Post-MVP: console booking + auto-charge.
sofia: I'll coordinate with billing to ensure charge is applied same day. Any objections?
rahul: none. I'll prototype the scheduling API and a quick runbook.
max: we'll need a metric to show impact on other tenants during the window (e.g., p99 shift).
sofia: agreed. That will be part of the acceptance criteria.
ops-bot: SR-442 status=accepted.
sofia: action items logged: rahul prototyping API, max validating region headroom, billing hooks in parallel. Will reconvene Tue.
rahul: adding a feature flag path and a safemode (auto-revoke if host utilization >90%).
